punchline: Gold medal, no scholarships: the prize the Rocket Boys actually got.
thirty_sec: The Big Creek Missile Agency won the gold and silver awards at the 1960 National Science Fair in Indianapolis, after Miss Riley pushed them to enter. Hickam says the fairs offered no scholarships, though the boys all went to college.
question: Would you still want the work if the prize turned out to be only applause?
key_contrast: The reward was the learning, with the medal as a bonus.
